import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,os,time
tok=os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN","")
def gh(q):
    u="https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q="+urllib.parse.quote(q)+"&sort=updated&order=desc&per_page=8"
    h={"Accept":"application/vnd.github+json","User-Agent":"curl"}
    if tok: h["Authorization"]=f"Bearer {tok}"
    try:
        r=urllib.request.Request(u,headers=h)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=40) as x: return json.load(x).get("items",[])
    except Exception as e: print("gh err",q,type(e).__name__); return []
qs=["uncensored+llm+created:>2026-11-10","free+api+credits+created:>2026-11-10",
    "llm+gateway+created:>2026-11-10","gpu+free+tier+created:>2026-11-10",
    "abliterated+created:>2026-11-10"]
seen=set()
for q in qs:
    for it in gh(q):
        n=it["full_name"]
        if n in seen: continue
        seen.add(n)
        print(f"[{it['created_at'][:10]}] {n} ⭐{it['stargazers_count']}")
        d=(it.get("description") or "")[:110]
        if d: print(f"     {d}")
